instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about watching television. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
I wasn't good when I was in school because I often spent time watching cartoons on TV. however, I now watch nature documentaries and TV shows about science, history, and business. This helps me expand my knowledge a lot compared to when I was in school.

Person B:
I know I have to spend time studying but there are so many great TV shows. especially horror tv shows, once you watch it, you will be glued to it and can't stop watching. Besides, these TV shows often last for many weeks.

Person C:
I often spend time watching news on TV in the evening when I'm free. In the past, I often watched the soccer team I like on TV, but they often lost, so I gave up watching them. Nowadays there are too many reality TV shows being shown on TV. Every time I see these shows, I turn it off and do more interesting things.

Person D:
My husband usually schedules TV viewing for the weekend, he usually watches football or documentaries. I'm the opposite. I just turn on the TV and it doesn't matter what program it is, because I just need to relax. However, I also want to update news about movies. not just movies, but also songs. I also find reality TV shows very entertaining.

questions.prompt: Who avoids watching reality TV programmes?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói hiện nay có quá nhiều chương trình truyền hình thực tế, và mỗi khi thấy các chương trình này, người nói sẽ tắt TV để làm việc khác thú vị hơn.
2. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói người này chỉ bật TV lên và không quan trọng đó là chương trình gì, miễn là giúp thư giãn. Điều này cho thấy họ không quá kén chọn chương trình để xem.
3. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói người này muốn cập nhật tin tức về phim, không chỉ phim mà cả các bài hát. Vì vậy người này muốn theo dõi thông tin mới về điện ảnh và âm nhạc.
4. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói trước đây người này hay xem đội bóng mình thích trên TV, nhưng đội đó thường thua nên họ đã từ bỏ việc xem.
5. Chọn A vì đoạn A nói hiện nay người này xem phim tài liệu thiên nhiên và các chương trình về khoa học, lịch sử, kinh doanh; việc đó giúp họ mở rộng kiến thức rất nhiều.
6. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói người này biết mình phải dành thời gian học, nhưng có quá nhiều chương trình TV hay, đặc biệt là chương trình kinh dị khiến họ xem mãi không dừng lại được.
7. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói những chương trình TV này thường kéo dài trong nhiều tuần. Điều này khớp với ý thích các chương trình tiếp diễn qua nhiều tuần.

instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about eating out and cooking at home. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
Going to a restaurant is for the social atmosphere and I am not bothered to eat alone either. What's important to me is the variety of dishes. Therefore, I eat at as many places as possible even though they are a bit pricey. That's why I joined the cooking club, where I can learn many new recipes and also meet many friends.

Person B:
When I was a kid, I was often given ready-made or junk food when I was at home, although I don't want to blame my parents. Since then, I try to eat at restaurants as much as possible. The food at the restaurant is not very diverse but for me that is not a problem. What matters to me when going out to eat is who you go with. I often eat with colleagues or close friends when I get off work, it's very fun.

Person C:
I don't understand why so many people want to find many different recipes for one dish. I know clearly what I like and I eat exactly that food. My dad is a good cook, he knows what ingredients I don't like to eat, which obviously are a lot. I love being home and eating with my family.

Person D:
I used to often go to the most fashionable and luxurious restaurants to eat. However, now, I'm back to being a student and my finances won't stretch that far. Therefore, I often cook for myself and watch recipes and cooking methods on the internet. That helps me to be able to focus on my studies without losing concentration.

questions.prompt: Who needs to save money?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn D vì D nói giờ quay lại làm sinh viên nên tài chính không cho phép ăn nhà hàng sang trọng nữa. => Cần tiết kiệm tiền.
2. Chọn A vì A nói đã tham gia cooking club để học nhiều công thức mới. => Tham gia kiểu lớp/CLB nấu ăn.
3. Chọn A vì A nói điều quan trọng là sự đa dạng món ăn nên ăn ở nhiều nơi nhất có thể. => Thích ăn nhiều loại món khác nhau.
4. Chọn C vì C nói biết rõ mình thích gì và chỉ ăn đúng những món đó. => Chỉ muốn ăn số ít món quen thuộc.
5. Chọn B vì B nói hay ăn với đồng nghiệp hoặc bạn thân sau giờ làm và thấy rất vui. => Thích ăn với bạn bè/người quen.
6. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói "I often cook for myself and watch recipes and cooking methods on the internet" — nói thẳng là thường tự nấu ăn.
7. Chọn C vì C nói thích ở nhà ăn cùng gia đình, bố nấu ăn ngon. => Thích đồ ăn nấu ở nhà.

instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about volunteering. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
I believe there are many ways we can show kindness through volunteering. I’m retired now, and I currently help build houses for people in need. I work with a volunteering organisation that already has clear plans in place. Through this work, I’ve had the chance to experience different foreign cultures. We’re often sent to various countries to carry out these projects, so it’s also a great way to travel while doing something meaningful. The job involves manual labour, so we’re able to improve our physical health – something that some people only begin to notice after a while.

Person B:
My mother told me to do local volunteering because she is part of that organisation, but I’m not into it. I prefer volunteering abroad because I can develop soft skills – something that will benefit my future career. Also, meeting new people helps me expand my network and create valuable connections I can use later in my professional life.

Person C:
Some people enjoy volunteering abroad, but honestly I feel most people are more interested in travelling. I believe we should use our time more meaningfully. Each town has many people in need. Their situations are difficult, and they don’t have the means to improve their quality of life. They are individuals who have contributed a lot to the country. Sharing stories with them helps us understand the differences between generations. We can also broaden our knowledge about local history, traditions, and culture through their experiences.

Person D:
I’m too busy and rarely have any free time to do anything, so spending even a few hours volunteering is difficult. I would have to take half a day off work. I see many people in need and they genuinely require some extra financial support. That’s something I can help with because I earn a good salary. Making monthly donations is not a problem for me – it’s how I show my support and contribution.

questions.prompt: Who thinks volunteering helps improve physical health?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn A vì đoạn A có câu "The job involves manual labour, so we're able to improve our physical health". Cụm "improve our physical health" là bằng chứng trực tiếp.
2. Chọn C vì đoạn C có câu "Each town has many people in need" và "we should use our time more meaningfully". Ý này cho thấy người nói nghĩ hoạt động tình nguyện nên giúp cộng đồng địa phương.
3. Chọn D vì đoạn D có câu "Making monthly donations is not a problem for me – it's how I show my support and contribution." Cụm "monthly donations" cho thấy người nói ủng hộ công việc thiện nguyện bằng tiền.
4. Chọn C vì đoạn C có câu "broaden our knowledge about local history, traditions, and culture". Đây là bằng chứng trực tiếp cho ý hiểu biết về văn hóa.
5. Chọn B vì đoạn B có câu "something that will benefit my future career." Cụm "future career" là từ khóa rõ nhất.
6. Chọn B vì đoạn B có câu "meeting new people helps me expand my network and create valuable connections". Đây là bằng chứng cho ý muốn gặp người mới và mở rộng quan hệ.
7. Chọn A vì đoạn A có câu "it's also a great way to travel while doing something meaningful." Cụm "a great way to travel" khớp trực tiếp với ý của câu hỏi.

Who supports charity work with money?
Who thinks volunteering can improve knowledge about culture?
Who wants to improve their future career?
Who wants to make new friends?
Who thinks volunteering is a way to travel?

instructions: Four people write reviews of a new restaurant in their town on a website. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
I'm not sure if I will return to this restaurant. I think the staff was arguing when I got there, because the atmosphere here was not very comfortable. As for the food, I think there's nothing to write about. I ordered fish and chips, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't good either. But many people say that the food here is fabulous. So, I think I'm an exception.

Person B:
This is a very famous restaurant that I saw in the newspaper. Sadly, I arrived later than the rest of the party, so I didn't get to order dinner. However, I ordered orange juice and mango juice and they were both delicious. What about the surroundings? Lively music along with fashionable and appropriate decor makes me feel very comfortable.

Person C:
I don't understand why this restaurant is so famous. When I arrived and saw a menu with lots of different dishes, I saw this as a bad sign. Furthermore, the menu with traditional dishes contrasting with the modern decoration style made me feel very confused and strange. The waiters here were also not friendly. This was one of my worst experiences eating at a restaurant.

Person D:
This is my first time coming to this restaurant. The food is very cheap but the quality is excellent. I was very surprised with the starter because its menu is very diverse. But there is one thing that I want the restaurant to improve. The restaurant band played live music but it was very far away, so the sound was very low and it didn't make the meal atmosphere lively. Next time turn the music louder, please!

questions.prompt: Who enjoyed the atmosphere?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn B vì người nói thích không khí nhà hàng nhỏ âm nhạc sôi động và cách trang trí đẹp.
2. Chọn D vì người nói than nhạc sống ở quá xa nên âm thanh nghe rất nhỏ.
3. Chọn B vì người nói đến muộn nên không kịp gọi bữa tối, chỉ uống nước trái cây.
4. Chọn C vì người nói xem đây là một trong những trải nghiệm tệ nhất nên chắc chắn không muốn quay lại.
5. Chọn A vì người nói cho rằng trải nghiệm tệ của mình có lẽ chỉ là trường hợp ngoại lệ, vì nhiều người vẫn khen nhà hàng này.
6. Chọn D vì người nói ấn tượng với menu món khai vị rất đa dạng.
7. Chọn A vì người nói đánh giá món ăn không tệ nhưng cũng không ngon, tức là chất lượng chỉ ở mức trung bình.

instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about reading books. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
I often keep a book on the bedside table to read before going to bed. The problem is, I get tired after reading only half of a page, and I fall asleep. So, I've been reading that one book for half a year now and have only read chapter 2. However, when I read factual books, I find it very interesting and it keeps me awake for hours.

Person B:
My job requires reading a lot of books. These books include a lot of facts and figures and they are very boring. When I have free time, I usually want to read light books, like mystery novels or comedy. I often read on the train to work. I have a young child, so when I come home I almost don't have time to read. Therefore, I have to read books when traveling by train. So, a book can last me 1 week.

Person C:
My wife often complains about not having time to read, and I say we have to make our own time. So, I often calculate my free time on my phone so I can know in advance whether I should bring a book to read on the train. My wife often laughs at me for doing so, but I don't mind, as long as I can finish reading so many books.

Person D:
I used to struggle very much to finish reading a book that we were expected to read. However, now that I read for my own pleasure, I don't mind too much. I usually don't limit myself to reading one at a time. There are so many titles I can choose from that get me excited. I have a list of books that I want to read in the future.

questions.prompt: Who has limited time to read books?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn B vì người nói có con nhỏ nên khi về nhà gần như không còn thời gian để đọc sách.
2. Chọn A vì người nói rất khó đọc xong một cuốn sách, đọc nửa năm mới tới chương 2.
3. Chọn B vì người nói thấy sách nhiều sự kiện và số liệu rất chán.
4. Chọn C vì người nói sắp xếp được thời gian đọc nhiều hơn cả vợ của mình.
5. Chọn C vì người nói tính trước thời gian rảnh để quyết định có mang sách theo đọc hay không.
6. Chọn D vì người nói nói rõ ràng mình không chỉ đọc một cuốn sách tại một thời điểm.
7. Chọn D vì người nói có sẵn một danh sách dài các cuốn sách muốn đọc trong tương lai.

instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about visiting the city of Stevenson. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
I went to this city last summer and really liked the atmosphere of this city. The reason I like the atmosphere here is because it has a lot of public performances. These performances often take place in front of department stores. So this prevents me from shopping inside those stores. I was very surprised when I came home with an empty bag and I didn't buy anything.

Person B:
When I go out, I only care about two things: good food and a good play. I especially liked the lunch I had in this city, it was delicious and I really want to come back here next time. However, I guess it's a bit expensive and I have to walk a long way to get there. However, it didn't matter because I had a wonderful day.

Person C:
I don't like big cities and rarely go out to cities. But I go to the Stevenson city very often. I go there about five to seven times a year. There is an area outside the city. In that area, there are many things that I need. There is a lot of water, a natural area, a small forest and a special camping area. I really like coming to this place to rest. It also has a great coffee serving area for visitors.

Person D:
When I first came to this city, I felt very scared because this city is very big. The city has many parts and the shopping part is very far from the green part. However, we already had the bus route and we signed up to take the bus for a full day. Buses are very cheap and very convenient. I feel very lucky to not have to put pressure on my sore feet.

questions.prompt: Who likes the natural area outside the city?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn C vì C thích khu vực bên ngoài thành phố vì có nước, thiên nhiên, rừng nhỏ, chỗ cắm trại. => Thích không gian nghỉ dưỡng tự nhiên ở đó.
2. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói rất may vì không phải gây áp lực lên đôi chân đau của mình. => Đi bộ nhiều gây vấn đề.
3. Chọn A vì đoạn A nói "I was very surprised when I came home with an empty bag and I didn't buy anything" — chữ "surprised" cho thấy bình thường người này VẪN mua đồ khi ghé cửa hàng, lần này không mua mới là chuyện bất ngờ.
4. Chọn A vì A nói thích không khí thành phố vì có nhiều public performances trước cửa hàng bách hóa. => Thích các buổi biểu diễn công cộng.
5. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói bữa trưa rất ngon nhưng "it's a bit expensive". => Đã trả khá nhiều tiền cho bữa ăn.
6. Chọn C vì C nói thường đến khu vực bên ngoài thành phố, nơi có thiên nhiên, khu cắm trại, quán cà phê. => Chỉ tập trung đến một khu nhất định.
7. Chọn D vì D nói xe buýt "very cheap and very convenient". => Người này đánh giá phương tiện công cộng tốt.

My forte in drawing is animals, especially big and ferocious animals.

I find going to see paintings similar to reading books. You must look and read before discussing. When I go to exhibitions with my friends, they often talk before seeing the painting, and what they talk about isn't even about the painting; that annoys me.

Person D:
I find polite art very fascinating. I often go to talks about art and I have gone to many foreign art exhibitions and artists' houses. It's great to see their works and where they worked.

questions.prompt: Who thinks visitors should focus on the art?
questions.explanation:

2. Chọn A vì người nói hiện nay thường đưa con đi xem triển lãm cùng mình.
3. Chọn B vì người nói thấy việc xem triển lãm hội tranh khá chán và quá yên lặng.

5. Chọn D vì người nói thường đến các buổi nói chuyện về nghệ thuật và tham quan nhiều triển lãm, cho thấy hiểu biết tốt về lĩnh vực này.

instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about plans for a new railway station. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
In my opinion, the bus is very clean and comfortable to travel. I find it has a lot of space for everyone, and the bus system is also very large. Therefore, I think improving the public transport system is unnecessary, while the old system is still good.

Person B:
Buses are often full of people, especially during rush hour. This makes me very uncomfortable when I have to travel to work by bus. The public transportation improvement plan proposed by the city is very reasonable and it will improve the above situation a lot.

Person C:
Building a new public transportation system will be very costly. And we all know it's at the expense of residents. I think we should use that money for something more beneficial, which is building more hospitals. Hospitals in this living area are very few.

Person D:
I see too many people who do not arrange a good time to travel to work, they often arrive at work late. I always think in advance about what time I will get to work tomorrow and what means of transport I will use.

questions.prompt: Who thinks the bus service is good?
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn A vì A nói bus sạch, thoải mái, có nhiều chỗ, hệ thống lớn. => Đánh giá xe buýt tốt.
2. Chọn C vì C nói nên dùng tiền đó để xây thêm bệnh viện vì bệnh viện trong khu này rất ít. => Cần cơ sở y tế tốt hơn.
3. Chọn C vì C nói xây hệ thống giao thông mới sẽ rất tốn kém. => Cho rằng trạm mới tốn quá nhiều tiền.
4. Chọn A vì A nói hệ thống bus sạch, thoải mái, rộng, nên việc cải thiện là không cần thiết. => Cho rằng hệ thống hiện tại không cần nâng cấp.
5. Chọn D vì D nói nhiều người không sắp xếp thời gian đi làm hợp lý nên hay đến muộn. => Mọi người nên lên kế hoạch di chuyển tốt hơn.
6. Chọn B vì B nói xe buýt thường đông người, đặc biệt giờ cao điểm. => Xe buýt quá đông.
7. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói "The public transportation improvement plan proposed by the city is very reasonable and it will improve the above situation a lot" — "the above situation" chính là cảnh xe buýt chật kín vào giờ cao điểm mà người này vừa than phiền ngay trước đó.

instructions: Four people respond in the comments section of an online magazine article about going on holiday. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
passage_text:
Person A:
My family and I often plan to travel every time we have a vacation. If the weather is nice then our plans go ahead as usual, if not, we will postpone that vacation. For my family, light wind and warm sunlight are important when we go out. A few of my friends invited me to go climbing, but I'm afraid of heights so I refused them. However, in the future I really want to try mountain climbing once.

Person B:

options: The economy during the Golden Age

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3: As their popularity increased, tulips transitioned from decorative items to commodities. They began to be sold in markets, sometimes even before they had bloomed. Merchants treated tulip bulbs like valuable assets, often purchasing them based on future availability. Buyers and sellers exchanged contracts instead of the actual flowers, betting on future prices. This speculative behavior turned the tulip into more than just a flower—it became a financial instrument, with its value fluctuating daily based on market trends and demand.
options: The economy during the Golden Age

questions.prompt: Paragraph 4: There are hundreds of tulip varieties, differing in color, shape, and pattern. options: The economy during the Golden Age

questions.prompt: Paragraph 5: The tulip trade operated on a complex system of contracts, options, and informal agreements. Because bulbs bloom only once a year, buyers often agreed on future purchases, sometimes without even seeing the flower. Specialized markets were established where traders could buy and sell tulip futures. Prices were agreed upon months in advance, and payments were made when the bulbs were delivered. This abstract trading model made it easier for speculators to participate, but it also disconnected the trade from the real value of the product itself.
options: The economy during the Golden Age

Traders carried these rare goods by land and sea, navigating a web of routes and tariffs. Each region had its own preferences, and what was fashionable in Amsterdam might not be as popular in Paris. Nonetheless, tulips remained a desirable item among European elites, and international trade routes helped spread both the flower and its financial influence across the continent.
options: The economy during the Golden Age

The tulip crash left a deep impact on the Dutch economy and became a cautionary tale still taught in economics courses today.
options: The economy during the Golden Age

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: The concept of yin and yang has a complex influence on Chinese cuisine. In fact, this concept also appears in many other areas of life. It can be understood that yin and yang are opposite elements that complement each other to achieve a certain balance. Sweet and sour, cold and hot are typical examples of this concept. Some foods can be classified into hot or cold groups, such as lemon is considered cold and onion is considered hot. Based on this concept, Chinese people choose suitable foods to maintain the balance of the body.

Paragraph 3: In addition to the concept of yin and yang directly influencing the culinary culture, the Chinese also pay close attention to the availability of ingredients. Each region has its own ingredients, and this leads to differences in regional cooking styles. The coastal areas in the south of the country are famous for seafood dishes. In the north, the widespread cultivation of wheat has led to noodle dishes. The southwestern regions are famous for spicy soups, while some regions are famous for grilled meat.

Paragraph 4: Cooking methods are also regionally specific, in addition to the differences in food in these regions. However, there are some food techniques that are considered to be standard in Chinese culture. For example, vegetables are cut into small pieces and eaten with chopsticks. The Chinese have a long history of using chopsticks. The Chinese also often leave fish and meat with bones. According to them, this makes the food more delicious. Steaming is a very popular form of cooking. In addition, frying food with cooking oil is also commonly used.

Paragraph 5: The most common way for Chinese people to eat is street food. It is very common to see stalls selling all kinds of food on both sides of the road. This has become a part of the food culture. For large dining events, the food is often placed in the middle of the table so that guests can try different dishes. The meal is served with tea and sometimes rice wine from the local area.

Paragraph 6: There are signs that Chinese food culture and eating habits are changing. Chinese people now consume a wide variety of foods from many different countries. People in cities also prefer fast and convenient foods. In addition, some traditional products such as milk are consumed less by Chinese people than in the past.

Paragraph 7: The change in Chinese eating habits has a global impact. Due to its huge population, the food demand of the Chinese market will directly affect domestic and international food production. The change in diet leads to problems such as the increase in related diseases that a large economy like China is prone to. Therefore, achieving a balance like the yin-yang philosophy in Chinese culinary culture is clearly a big challenge.

Some vegetarians avoid meat but still eat dairy and eggs—these are called lacto-ovo vegetarians. Others, like vegans, avoid all animal-derived products, including honey and gelatin. There are also pescatarians, who exclude meat but still consume fish. Flexitarians mostly eat plant-based foods but occasionally include meat or fish. These variations show that a meatless diet can be adapted to individual needs and beliefs, making it a flexible and increasingly popular choice for people around the world.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing
questions.explanation:
1. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn giới thiệu nhiều hình thức ăn chay khác nhau chứ không coi ăn chay là một lựa chọn duy nhất.
2. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn trình bày rằng con người chọn chế độ ăn không thịt vì nhiều động cơ như tôn giáo, đạo đức, môi trường và sức khỏe.
3. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn trả lời trực tiếp câu hỏi liệu con người có thể sống mà không ăn thịt hay không.
4. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn tập trung phê phán tác động xấu của mô hình chăn nuôi công nghiệp đối với động vật và môi trường.
5. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn cho thấy cốt lõi đạo đức của nhiều người ăn chay là sự tôn trọng mọi sinh vật.
6. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nêu các lợi ích sức khỏe thường được báo cáo khi chuyển sang chế độ ăn nhiều thực vật.
7. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn liên hệ việc giảm ăn thịt với trách nhiệm chung trong bảo vệ môi trường toàn cầu.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: People adopt meatless diets for many different reasons. For some, religious beliefs guide their eating habits, while others avoid meat out of concern for animal welfare. Some are motivated by environmental issues, believing that reducing meat consumption lowers their carbon footprint. Health is also a major factor, as some studies link vegetarian diets to lower risks of heart disease and diabetes. The motivations are as varied as the people who choose them, and it's not uncommon for individuals to follow a plant-based lifestyle for a combination of reasons.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3: Many people wonder if it's truly possible to live without eating meat. The answer is yes, as proven by millions of vegetarians and vegans worldwide. While it requires some planning to ensure a balanced intake of protein, iron, and vitamin B12, plant-based diets can be nutritionally complete. In fact, major health organizations have stated that well-planned vegetarian and vegan diets are suitable for all stages of life, including childhood and pregnancy. With a variety of plant-based options now available, choosing a meatless lifestyle is more practical than ever.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing

questions.prompt: Paragraph 4: Factory farming—the industrialized method of raising animals for food—has been criticized for its negative effects on both animals and the environment. Animals are often kept in cramped, stressful conditions, and the use of antibiotics to promote growth raises concerns about resistance. Additionally, factory farms contribute to pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. These harmful impacts are among the key reasons why some people choose to reduce or eliminate meat from their diet. Supporting ethical and sustainable food sources is becoming a growing priority for many consumers.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing
questions.correct_answer: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing

questions.prompt: Paragraph 5: At the core of many vegetarian beliefs is the idea of respecting all forms of life. For some, avoiding meat is a moral decision rooted in the belief that animals have the right to live without suffering. This perspective emphasizes empathy, compassion, and non-violence. It is also reflected in certain spiritual or religious practices where harming living beings is discouraged. Choosing a meatless diet becomes more than just a personal choice—it represents a commitment to treating all creatures with dignity and care.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing

questions.prompt: Paragraph 6: A common benefit reported by people who switch to a plant-based diet is improved health. Many experience lower cholesterol levels, better digestion, and increased energy. Vegetarian diets are often rich in fiber, antioxidants, and healthy fats. Studies show that people who consume more fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes tend to have lower risks of heart disease and obesity. However, balance is key—a diet full of processed plant foods can still be unhealthy. When done right, a meatless diet can be a strong foundation for a healthy lifestyle.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing

questions.prompt: Paragraph 7: Reducing meat consumption can also be seen as a global responsibility. Livestock farming is a major contributor to climate change, water usage, and deforestation. By choosing plant-based options, individuals can lower their environmental impact and support a more sustainable food system. Small changes made by many people can have a big collective effect. From conserving water to reducing greenhouse gas emissions, a meatless diet can be a meaningful step toward addressing some of the planet’s most urgent environmental challenges.
options: Factory farming - it is a harmful thing

questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: In today's fast-changing world, free time is no longer defined only by outdoor games, books, or face-to-face gatherings. With the rise of smartphones, streaming services, and social media, people now spend much of their leisure time online. This shift has changed not only how people relax, but also how they connect, learn, and entertain themselves.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities
questions.correct_answer: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
questions.explanation:
1. Heading: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nói rằng thời gian giải trí không còn chỉ gắn với trò chơi ngoài trời, sách hay gặp gỡ trực tiếp, mà đã được định nghĩa lại trong bối cảnh kỹ thuật số. Vietnamese translation: Trong thế giới thay đổi nhanh hiện nay, thời gian rảnh không còn chỉ được gắn với trò chơi ngoài trời, sách hay những buổi gặp mặt trực tiếp. Cùng với sự phát triển của điện thoại thông minh, dịch vụ streaming và mạng xã hội, con người ngày nay dành phần lớn thời gian giải trí trên mạng. Sự chuyển dịch này không chỉ thay đổi cách mọi người thư giãn mà còn ảnh hưởng đến cách họ kết nối, học hỏi và giải trí.
2. Heading: Enhancing connectivity with mobile apps Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh rằng ứng dụng di động đã thay đổi cách mọi người liên lạc và giúp họ kết nối tức thì với bạn bè, gia đình và đồng nghiệp. Vietnamese translation: Ứng dụng di động đã thay đổi cách mọi người giao tiếp và giữ liên lạc. Thông qua nền tảng nhắn tin, cuộc gọi video và ứng dụng mạng xã hội, người dùng có thể lập tức kết nối với bạn bè, gia đình và đồng nghiệp bất kể khoảng cách. Những công cụ này làm cho việc giao tiếp trở nên nhanh hơn, tiện lợi hơn và có tính tương tác hơn bao giờ hết.
3. Heading: Promoting essential digital literacy Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn khẳng định rằng digital literacy giúp con người tiếp cận thông tin, đánh giá nội dung trực tuyến và tự bảo vệ mình, nên đó là kỹ năng số thiết yếu. Vietnamese translation: Khi công nghệ số trở thành một phần trung tâm của cuộc sống hiện đại, khả năng sử dụng thiết bị và nền tảng trực tuyến một cách hiệu quả ngày càng quan trọng. Hiểu biết số giúp mọi người tiếp cận thông tin, đánh giá nội dung trên mạng, giao tiếp có trách nhiệm và tự bảo vệ mình trước tin sai lệch cũng như các rủi ro trực tuyến. Hiện nay, đây được xem là kỹ năng thiết yếu cho học tập, công việc và cuộc sống hàng ngày.
4. Heading: Risks of Excessive Screen-Based Entertainment Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn cảnh báo rằng giải trí quá nhiều qua màn hình có thể giảm vận động, làm rối loạn giấc ngủ và hạn chế tương tác xã hội ngoài đời thực. Vietnamese translation: Mặc dù giải trí qua màn hình như chơi game, xem streaming và sử dụng mạng xã hội có thể rất thú vị, việc dành quá nhiều thời gian cho những hoạt động này có thể gây ra tác động tiêu cực. Sử dụng màn hình quá mức có thể làm giảm hoạt động thể chất, gây rối loạn giấc ngủ và hạn chế tương tác xã hội trong đời sống thật. Vì lý do đó, nhiều người lo ngại về việc cân bằng giải trí kỹ thuật số với những thói quen lành mạnh hơn.
5. Heading: Concerns About Data Privacy Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nói rõ rằng nhiều người lo lắng về cách dữ liệu cá nhân của họ bị thu thập, lưu trữ và sử dụng trên các nền tảng số. Vietnamese translation: Khi ngày càng nhiều thông tin cá nhân được chia sẻ trên mạng, nhiều người dùng bắt đầu lo ngại về cách dữ liệu của họ bị thu thập, lưu trữ và sử dụng. Ứng dụng di động, website và các nền tảng mạng xã hội thường theo dõi hành vi người dùng, đôi khi không có sự đồng ý rõ ràng hoặc giải thích đầy đủ. Những thực hành này đã làm dấy lên những câu hỏi nghiêm túc về bảo mật, tính minh bạch và việc bảo vệ quyền riêng tư cá nhân.
6. Heading: Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh rằng không gian mạng chỉ thật sự hữu ích khi người dùng tương tác với nhau một cách tôn trọng, bao dung và hỗ trợ. Vietnamese translation: Internet kết nối con người từ nhiều bối cảnh, nền văn hóa và góc nhìn khác nhau, tạo ra cơ hội hợp tác và thấu hiểu lẫn nhau. Tuy nhiên, không gian trực tuyến chỉ thật sự có lợi khi người dùng giao tiếp theo cách tôn trọng và hỗ trợ. Việc khuyến khích sự tử tế, bao dung và giao tiếp có trách nhiệm là điều thiết yếu để xây dựng những cộng đồng trực tuyến hòa nhập và tôn trọng lẫn nhau.
7. Heading: Prioritize human-friendly designs Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn tập trung vào việc nhà thiết kế nên tạo ra hệ thống đơn giản, dễ tiếp cận và thoải mái, đồng thời tính đến nhu cầu, khả năng và trải nghiệm của người dùng. Vietnamese translation: Khi phát triển các nền tảng và công nghệ số, nhà thiết kế nên tập trung tạo ra những hệ thống đơn giản, dễ tiếp cận và thoải mái cho con người sử dụng. Thiết kế thân thiện với con người xem xét nhu cầu, khả năng và trải nghiệm của người dùng, qua đó làm cho công nghệ trở nên hòa nhập hơn và ít gây ức chế hơn. Cách tiếp cận này giúp bảo đảm công cụ số phục vụ con người một cách hiệu quả thay vì làm họ bị quá tải.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: Mobile applications have transformed the way people communicate and stay in touch. Through messaging platforms, video calls, and social networking apps, users can instantly connect with friends, family, and coworkers regardless of distance. These tools make communication faster, more convenient, and more interactive than ever before.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3: As digital technology becomes a central part of modern life, the ability to use devices and online platforms effectively is increasingly important. Digital literacy helps people access information, evaluate online content, communicate responsibly, and protect themselves from misinformation and online risks. It is now considered an essential skill for education, work, and daily living.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities

questions.prompt: Paragraph 4: Although screen-based entertainment such as gaming, streaming, and social media can be enjoyable, spending too much time on these activities may have negative effects. Excessive screen use can reduce physical activity, disrupt sleep patterns, and limit real-life social interaction. For this reason, many people are concerned about balancing digital entertainment with healthier habits.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities

Mobile apps, websites, and social platforms often track user behavior, sometimes without clear consent or explanation. These practices have raised serious questions about security, transparency, and the protection of personal privacy.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities

questions.prompt: Paragraph 6: The internet connects people from different backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives, creating opportunities for collaboration and understanding. However, online spaces can only be truly beneficial when users interact in respectful and supportive ways. Encouraging kindness, tolerance, and responsible communication is essential for building inclusive and respectful online communities.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities
questions.correct_answer: Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities

questions.prompt: Paragraph 7: When developing digital platforms and technologies, designers should focus on creating systems that are simple, accessible, and comfortable for people to use. Human-friendly designs take into account users' needs, abilities, and experiences, making technology more inclusive and less frustrating. This approach helps ensure that digital tools serve people effectively rather than overwhelming them.
options: Redefining Leisure in the Digital era
Building Inclusive and Respectful Online Communities

questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: In the early 18th century, London’s roads were often muddy, overcrowded, and difficult to travel on. As a result, the River Thames served as the main “highway” through the city. People frequently used water taxis-small boats rowed by trained professionals called watermen-to move around quickly. These water journeys were not only faster but often safer than traveling by road. For many Londoners, taking a boat was the most efficient way to attend work, markets, or social events. The Doggett’s race, therefore, celebrates not just rowing skill, but the essential role that watermen played in daily life during that time.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives
questions.explanation:
1. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn giải thích rằng vào đầu thế kỷ XVIII, đi lại trên sông Thames thuận tiện hơn đường bộ nên trở thành cách di chuyển chính.
2. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn kể rằng cuộc đua ra đời từ việc Thomas Doggett suýt chết đuối rồi được cứu sống.
3. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn tập trung vào chiếc áo đỏ và huy hiệu bạc như phần thưởng mang ý nghĩa lịch sử của cuộc đua.
4. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nêu cuộc tranh luận về việc có nên hiện đại hóa cuộc đua để duy trì sức hút trong thời hiện đại hay không.
5. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn cho thấy chiến thắng cuộc đua mang lại uy tín và cơ hội nghề nghiệp trong cộng đồng watermen.
6. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh truyền thống gia đình nhiều thế hệ cùng tham gia và thậm chí chiến thắng cuộc đua.
7. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh rằng cuộc đua không có phần thưởng tài chính nên động lực chính là danh dự và truyền thống.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: The Doggett’s Coat and Badge race was established in 1715 by Thomas Doggett, an Irish actor and theatre manager, who became well known in London. According to popular accounts, Doggett once narrowly escaped drowning while traveling on the River Thames. To express his gratitude for the boatman who saved him and to honor the newly crowned King George I, he created this race. It was open to young watermen who had recently completed their apprenticeships, giving them a chance to demonstrate their rowing skills. Over time, this event became not just a tribute to a personal event, but a long-standing tradition that celebrates both history and the craft of rowing on the Thames.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3: The prize awarded to the winner of the Doggett’s Coat and Badge race is unlike any ordinary trophy. Instead of money or medals, the champion receives a traditional red coat and a silver badge. These items are deeply symbolic and represent the pride and respect historically associated with watermen. Each piece is custom-made for the winner and presented in a formal ceremony that highlights the cultural importance of the event. The coat reflects 18th-century styles, while the badge often includes royal imagery and references to the Thames. This unique reward continues to connect the modern race with its historical roots and honors the profession’s heritage.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives
questions.correct_answer: Origins of what the winner receives

questions.prompt: Paragraph 4: Although the Doggett’s race remains one of the oldest sporting events in the world, some have raised concerns about its future. With modern boats, technology, and shifting interests among younger generations, participation has declined in recent decades. Suggestions have been made to modernize the race to keep it relevant-perhaps by changing the route, updating the boats, or increasing promotion on social media. Others argue that preserving tradition is more important than making it popular. This ongoing discussion reflects broader challenges faced by many traditional events in the modern world: how to honor the past while adapting to the present.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives

questions.prompt: Paragraph 5: Winning the Doggett’s Coat and Badge race is not just about rowing fast-it’s about gaining respect within a close-knit community. For many, this competition represents an important rite of passage. It is often the first time a newly qualified waterman competes on such a historic stage. Success in the race can lead to recognition, offers from exclusive rowing clubs, and opportunities to participate in ceremonial roles along the Thames. Even those who do not win often benefit from simply being involved. The reputation built through this race can carry weight throughout a rower’s career, especially in London’s traditional maritime circles.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives

questions.prompt: Paragraph 6: One of the most heartwarming aspects of the Doggett’s race is its multi-generational appeal. In several families, competing in the race is a proud tradition passed from one generation to the next. It’s not uncommon to hear stories of grandfathers, fathers, and sons all having taken part over the years. Some families even have multiple winners across decades. These personal connections add emotional depth to the event and preserve its history in living memory. For these families, the race is more than a competition-it’s a legacy. The bond between relatives strengthens as they share stories, train together, and wear the symbolic red coat with pride.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives

questions.prompt: Paragraph 7: Unlike many modern sports competitions, the Doggett’s Coat and Badge race offers no financial reward. The red coat and silver badge have cultural and emotional value, but not monetary. Contestants take part out of pride, tradition, and a deep respect for the waterman’s profession. Many dedicate months to training, not for riches but for the honor of winning one of Britain’s most historic races. The lack of financial incentive may even enhance the race’s prestige, showing that commitment to heritage and community can outweigh commercial interests. In today’s world, that kind of motivation stands out as truly admirable.
options: Not in it for the money
Origins of what the winner receives
questions.correct_answer: Not in it for the money

questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: In recent years, the concept of health has expanded to include more than just physical well-being. Holistic approaches emphasize the interconnectedness of the body, mind, and environment, encouraging individuals to consider emotional balance, mental clarity, nutrition, and lifestyle habits all together. This broader perspective helps people achieve deeper and more sustainable wellness by addressing multiple aspects of their lives rather than isolated symptoms.
questions.explanation:
1. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn cho thấy khái niệm sức khỏe ngày nay đã mở rộng ra ngoài thể chất để bao gồm tinh thần, cảm xúc và môi trường sống.
2. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn tập trung vào việc nâng cao nhận thức, giảm kỳ thị và khuyến khích mọi người tìm kiếm sự hỗ trợ sớm.
3. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh lợi ích của các hoạt động thể dục theo nhóm đối với cả sức khỏe thể chất lẫn quan hệ xã hội.
4. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn cảnh báo rằng các chế độ ăn thịnh hành thường hứa hẹn nhanh nhưng có thể thiếu cơ sở khoa học và gây mất cân bằng dinh dưỡng.
5. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nói trực tiếp về nguy cơ từ các thông tin sức khỏe thiếu chính xác lan truyền trên mạng.
6. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn đề cao vai trò của các nhóm hỗ trợ trong việc duy trì động lực và trách nhiệm với mục tiêu sức khỏe.
7. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh rằng sức khỏe lâu dài đến từ các điều chỉnh nhỏ nhưng duy trì được, chứ không phải giải pháp tạm thời.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: Mental health has increasingly become a priority in public health discussions. Awareness campaigns aim to reduce the stigma around mental illnesses and encourage people to talk openly about their struggles. Providing education on recognizing early signs of anxiety, depression, and stress empowers individuals to seek help sooner. Many organizations also offer support networks and resources to foster a more compassionate and understanding society.

Paragraph 3: Community-based fitness initiatives are gaining popularity as a way to make exercise more enjoyable and accessible. By participating in group activities like yoga classes, walking clubs, or sports leagues, people not only improve their physical health but also build meaningful social connections. These programs create a sense of belonging and motivate individuals to stick with their fitness goals over time, contributing to healthier and happier communities.

Paragraph 4: Although fad diets often promise rapid weight loss or improved health, relying too heavily on these trends can be problematic. Many popular diets lack scientific backing and may exclude important nutrients, leading to imbalanced nutrition. Nutrition experts stress that sustainable eating should focus on balanced meals, moderation, and personal needs rather than quick fixes. Developing a healthy relationship with food is more beneficial than following the latest diet craze.

Paragraph 5: The rise of social media and online platforms has led to widespread sharing of health information, but not all of it is accurate or safe. Misinformation about supplements, treatments, and health practices can cause confusion or even harm. It is important for individuals to critically evaluate sources, consult healthcare professionals, and rely on evidence-based guidance when making decisions about their wellness routines.

Paragraph 6: Supportive groups focused on wellness play a crucial role in helping people maintain healthy lifestyles. Whether online forums or local meetups, these communities offer encouragement, share tips, and provide accountability. questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: The history of early Australians stretches back much further than previously believed, with evidence suggesting human presence on the Australian continent dating back approximately 65,000 years. This timeline challenges traditional views held by historians regarding the first human settlers in Australia. questions.explanation:
1. Chọn "An alternative history of settlement" vì câu chủ đề nói lịch sử người Úc cổ xa hơn nhiều so với trước đây (65,000 năm), thách thức quan điểm truyền thống về những người định cư đầu tiên — tức bức tranh lịch sử định cư đang được viết lại. 3. Chọn "Technology helps uncover the ocean's secret" vì đoạn nói remote sensing và GIS giúp phát hiện chuỗi đảo nối liền thành con đường di cư dưới biển.

6. Chọn "Lack of knowledge and skills" vì đoạn nêu ý kiến hoài nghi rằng người cổ không đủ năng lực trí tuệ, kiến thức và kỹ năng hàng hải để vượt đại dương.

In addition to the early settlers, scientists have uncovered traces of two other human groups that migrated to the continent. The presence of multiple groups suggests a complex history of human migration and interaction. questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: It's often thought that mountaineering has never attracted much serious attention - a niche pursuit that only became popular once modern equipment made the peaks accessible. There is clear evidence, however, that people were treating climbing as a demanding sport long before the era of social media. What is different in modern times is that many people now define conquering a mountain as standing on its summit - the particular thrill of being on top of the very thing you have just overcome, with the whole landscape spread out below, rather than relying on the photographs and accounts that other climbers have provided.
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn "Our changing perspective towards mountains" vì đoạn văn so sánh xưa – nay: người ta từng nghĩ leo núi là thú chơi hẹp, nhưng có bằng chứng leo núi đã là môn thể thao nghiêm túc từ lâu; điều KHÁC biệt bây giờ là định nghĩa "chinh phục" = đứng trên đỉnh, tự mình nhìn xuống thay vì nhờ ảnh và lời kể của người khác.
2. Chọn "A unique sense of achievement" vì đoạn văn nói về cảm giác thành tựu sâu sắc (profound sense of accomplishment): hình dáng núi tượng trưng cho chinh phục, vượt nỗi sợ, đẩy giới hạn, cộng thêm adrenaline khiến người leo quay lại mãi.
3. Chọn "Publicising one's achievements" vì đoạn văn nói selfie trên đỉnh gần như bắt buộc — bằng chứng và cách để mọi người biết; sự thoả mãn riêng tư giờ được đăng, gắn giờ, chia sẻ (posted, timestamped and shared).
4. Chọn "The wrong priority" vì đoạn văn chỉ ra người leo tập trung vào bức ảnh hơn ngọn núi, coi hành trình chỉ là chướng ngại, bỏ qua cảnh báo → tai nạn; "personal image ends up mattering more than safety or responsibility" = đặt sai ưu tiên.
5. Chọn "A disturbing revelation" vì đoạn văn mở bằng kỳ vọng Everest vắng vẻ rồi lật lại "The reality is startling": ảnh "traffic jam" trên death zone, rác mỗi mùa, thử thách cá nhân thành cuộc đua thương mại. Bẫy: đoạn 4 cũng nói tai nạn nhưng không "hé lộ" sự thật gây sốc.
6. Chọn "A focus on sustainability" vì đoạn văn nói về cách vận hành expedition đổi theo hướng bảo vệ môi trường: giới hạn permit, đặt cọc trả lại khi mang rác xuống, clean-up climbs, "a mountain should be left cleaner than it was found".
7. Chọn "A more intimate relationship" vì đoạn văn kể Nan Shepherd đi "into the hills rather than up them", biết núi như biết một người bạn — "one visits a friend with no intention but to be with him".
👉 Mẹo: đọc câu đầu + câu cuối mỗi đoạn; các cặp dễ nhầm là đoạn 3/4 (đăng ảnh vs ưu tiên sai) và đoạn 4/5 (tai nạn vs sự thật gây sốc ở Everest).

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: Climbing a mountain often leads to a profound sense of accomplishment. Because of their very shape, rising steeply to a single point, mountains stand for conquest and struggle, and reaching the top of one carries that meaning with it. But there is more to it than that: it represents not just reaching a physical summit but also conquering personal fears and pushing one's limits, creating memories that last a lifetime. There is also the adrenaline rush that comes with it - the same surge of excitement that draws people to other adventure sports, and one reason why so many climbers return to the mountains long after they have proved whatever they set out to prove.

Paragraph 3: Reaching the summit is no longer enough on its own. Taking a selfie at the top has become almost obligatory - the proof that the climb actually happened, and the means by which everyone else gets to hear about it. What was once a private satisfaction is now something to be posted, timestamped and shared within hours of the descent. This turns personal milestones into public spectacles that can inspire others, though it also raises awkward questions about authenticity: whether the climb was made for its own sake, or for the picture at the end of it.

Paragraph 4: In recent years, some climbers have become more focused on the photograph than on the mountain itself. Only the summit seems to count, as if there were nothing beautiful about the journey up, as if the hours of effort and the shifting landscape were merely an obstacle between the climber and the picture. Warnings go unheeded because nobody wants to turn back empty-handed, and in some cases this obsession with online fame has led to serious accidents. Reaching a major peak now also demands complicated organisation - permits, guides, bottled oxygen, a support team booked months in advance - and all of this can detract from the enjoyment of the climb. Personal image ends up mattering more than safety or responsibility.

Paragraph 5: You might expect the world's highest mountain to be an empty place - so hostile, so far beyond ordinary human endurance that hardly anyone would set foot there. The reality is startling. Photographs from recent seasons show a "traffic jam" of climbers on Everest, queuing along a single fixed rope in the death zone, waiting hours for their turn at the top. When a weather window opens, the ascent effectively becomes a race between them, the other climbers and the weather itself. Meanwhile the slopes carry the waste of every season, and what was once a personal challenge has become a commercial race measured in photographs and fame rather than respect for the mountain.

Paragraph 6: The pressure on high-altitude environments has forced a change in how expeditions are run. Authorities in several climbing regions now issue only a limited number of permits each season, and operators are required to lodge a deposit that is returned only once they bring their rubbish back down with them. Some teams organise clean-up climbs, whose purpose is not the summit at all but the removal of equipment and waste abandoned by earlier parties. Behind these measures lies a shift in what counts as a successful trip: protecting the slopes now matters as much as standing on top of them, and a mountain should be left cleaner than it was found.

Paragraph 7: For most people a mountain is something to be conquered - a summit to be reached, a target to be ticked off. The Scottish writer Nan Shepherd saw it differently. She grew up within sight of the Cairngorms and spent a lifetime walking the same range, setting down what she found there in The Living Mountain. She went into the hills rather than up them, returning to the same corries and burns until she knew them the way one comes to know a person rather than a place: to be with the mountain as “one visits a friend with no intention but to be with him”.

passage_text: The Arrival of the Four-Day Work Week (Version 2)

questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: Proponents of the four-day week believe the time has come for change. They argue that working patterns have been modified throughout history. In the Western world, for example, industrialisation resulted in 48 hours of working per week. The idea of a two-day weekend was first introduced by car magnate Henry Ford about a century ago. The customary 40-hour workweek is still anchored in this industrial setting, where workers stayed outside of home, in the factories and other facilities. This is no longer the norm among 21st-century workers, as many jobs can be undertaken remotely using modern technology.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people
questions.correct_answer: A way of life now out of date
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. "A way of life now out of date" → tuần 40 giờ "anchored in this industrial setting" của Henry Ford một thế kỷ trước, "no longer the norm among 21st-century workers".
2. "Benefits for employees" → "keep the workers away from stress", "more free time", "reduce gender inequality" — toàn lợi ích cho người lao động.
3. "Undesirable financial consequences" → "Employers are motivated by profit", "They fear staff producing 20% less for the same pay", và bài học Nhật 1988: "economic output was 20% lower", "a sharp rise in running costs". Cả đoạn nói về tiền của doanh nghiệp.
4. "Unforeseen challenges for employees" → "a theory called the hedonic treadmill: people will repeatedly return to their baseline of happiness"; công ty Pháp giảm giờ làm nhưng "failed to improve employee happiness"; làm nhanh hơn thì "Accidents may occur", "some people may be asked to leave the company". Bẫy: lợi nhuận của employers đã nằm ở đoạn 3, đoạn này là hệ quả bất ngờ với chính người lao động.
5. "Difficult to change old habits" → "some employees went back to the factory floor of their own accord", "others picked up a second job" — được nghỉ vẫn quay về nếp cũ. Bẫy: hai câu đầu nhắc năng suất tăng trong sáu tháng và "the novelty of change", dễ kéo sang ý khác; trọng tâm đoạn nằm ở nửa sau.
6. "An unfair plan for some people" → "Is it even workable? What about schoolteachers?" — giáo viên không thể làm ít đi vì số học sinh và khối lượng phải dạy vẫn thế; "Hospitals take in the same number of patients... how can doctors and nurses work any less?"; "It is the same for the police and firefighters". Kế hoạch chỉ hợp với một số nghề → bất công với những nghề còn lại. Bẫy: câu cuối nhắc "income" dễ kéo sang "Undesirable financial consequences".
7. "Alternative solutions worth considering" → "Raising the basic income", "adding more national holidays and bank holidays".
Nhiễu: "Businesses preparing for a new policy" — không đoạn nào nói doanh nghiệp đang chuẩn bị áp dụng.
👉 Mẹo: đoạn 3 và đoạn 4 dễ lẫn. Tiền của doanh nghiệp thì về đoạn 3; hạnh phúc, tai nạn, mất việc của người lao động thì về đoạn 4.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: But why should a four-day workweek be considered? The advocates suggest that working one day less will keep the workers away from stress-inducing work for longer. By having more free time, workers can pursue pastimes or be with their friends and their loved ones. The supporters also argue that reducing work hours can reduce gender inequality in the workplace. Women mostly carry out the childcare duties, so they cannot pursue employment or careers. The proposal will go some way to negate this, although there are childcare facilities that can deal with the task.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3: Although the proposal for a four-day workweek sounds appealing, there are wider issues to consider. Employers are motivated by profit, and maintaining a high level of productivity is important to them. They fear staff producing 20% less for the same pay. The historical example of Japan, where the workweek was reduced from 44 to 30 hours in 1988, provides a cautionary tale. In the period between then and 1996, economic output was 20% lower than it would have been, and businesses saw a sharp rise in running costs as they hired and trained extra staff to cover the missing hours.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people

questions.prompt: Paragraph 4: Supporters argue that shorter hours simply make people happier. Some question this notion, citing a theory called the hedonic treadmill: people will repeatedly return to their baseline of happiness, no matter what happened to them. There is evidence for it. Large French companies which reduced their working hours from 38 to 32 reported that they failed to improve employee happiness. Cramming the same amount of work into a shorter period of time may lead to work being done at a much faster rate. Accidents may occur. Workers who work faster cannot concentrate as well, and some people may be asked to leave the company.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people

questions.prompt: Paragraph 5: The proposal of a shorter working week may be unfounded. However, some companies actually reported increased productivity over a six-month period, though the employees may be stimulated by the novelty of change. There is also the question of income. Fewer hours on the clock can mean a smaller income, and for workers on modest wages that difference matters. Others find the empty day harder to fill than they imagined, and boredom sets in when there is little to occupy them. Where shorter weeks have been tried on a national scale, the results have been telling: some employees went back to the factory floor of their own accord, while others picked up a second job to fill the hours they had just been given.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people

questions.prompt: Paragraph 6: So, the utopian rhetoric around the virtues of a shorter working week may be unfounded. Is it even workable? What about schoolteachers? The number of students will stay the same, and the amount they have to learn will not diminish. There will not be a rapid rise in the number of this profession in a short period of time. Hospitals take in the same number of patients whether the week is four days or five, so how can doctors and nurses work any less? It is the same for the police and firefighters. The crime rate will not suddenly decrease, and the number of emergencies will stay the same. Employees' income will be reduced in line with their shorter working hours.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people
questions.correct_answer: An unfair plan for some people

questions.prompt: Paragraph 7: Many people remain unconvinced by the case for cutting working hours, and point instead to other ways of reaching the same goal. Raising the basic income would leave workers better able to meet their necessities without touching the timetable at all. There is also the idea of adding more national holidays and bank holidays, when companies are obliged to pay their staff, so that everyone gains extra rest without a single business having to restructure the way it operates. Whatever the outcome, the debate over working time looks unlikely to be settled any time soon.
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people
